name: Capital One Venture X Rewards Credit Card

loungeAccess.notes: Unlimited Priority Pass visits worldwide (1,300+ lounges). First 2 guests complimentary at Priority Pass locations; $35/guest after. Capital One Lounge access included. Additional authorized cardholders also receive lounge access.

tripDelay.notes: Covers cardholder, spouse, and dependent children under 22. Must file within 30 days at eclaimsline.com or call 800-825-4062.

covers: death, injury or illness of cardholder or immediate family member
tripCancellation.notes: IMPORTANT: Only covers airline/bus/train/ferry tickets — does NOT cover prepaid tours or hotel reservations. Very limited covered reasons compared to Chase/Amex.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Door-to-door coverage when common carrier fare charged to card. Contact: Broadspire at 855-307-9248.

emergencyMedical.notes: No dedicated emergency medical evacuation benefit. Visa Infinite provides some assistance services but does not cover evacuation costs.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Primary coverage — Venture X is the only Capital One personal card with primary rental coverage (vs secondary for regular Venture).

otherCredits.name: Annual Travel Credit
otherCredits.notes: $300 in statement credits for bookings made through Capital One Travel portal.

otherCredits.name: Anniversary Bonus
otherCredits.notes: 10,000 bonus miles every account anniversary (worth ~$100 toward travel).

rewards.travelRate: 10x miles on hotels and rental cars booked via Capital One Travel; 5x on flights via Capital One Travel

pointValue.transferPartners: varies (often 0.01-0.015+ with transfer partners like Air Canada Aeroplan, Turkish Miles&Smiles, etc.)

travelPerks: Priority Pass Select — unlimited visits to 1,300+ lounges worldwide
Capital One Lounge access (DFW, DEN, IAD)
1:1 point transfer to 15+ airline and hotel partners
bestFor: Travelers seeking premium perks at a more accessible fee — excellent lounge access, primary rental coverage, and 2x on everything
